scope: Passive2-second exact-PID CPU/RSS/log-size observation of browser audit. No benchmarks or server restarts. One separately recorded parent-authorized status GET at19:17:23.789UTC is the only observer-issued request.

handoff.accounting: Global cumulativeCPU difference uses the same process identity once. Continuous samples switch from live-1 to live-2 only after live-1 ends; overlap is not summed.

coverage_gap.cause: Unknown; live-2 stopped writing without completion/error marker, exec session was no longer available, and later scoped process check found no audit observer. Preserve its original complete=false summary.
coverage_gap.limitations: Aggregate process CPU delta is known from endpoints; timing, interveningRSS and per-action attribution are unavailable. C036loops2/3 and its first idle interval fall in this gap.

final_idle.interpretation: Server retained stableRSS; idleCPU was low but nonzero. Background CPU source not traced. This later quiet window is distinct from the unsampled initial C036idle interval.

cold_transit_navigation.finding: First cold transit-p-1 member navigation materializes and indexes its full selected-node history; one-materialized-node cache evicts the prior idle member. Outer ten-node assembly is reused. Observed47s includes initialization and subsequent frontend queries.

c036.interpretation: Automation action-to-observation timings are not pure UI latency. Only early loop1 has full passive coverage; no timing/per-stepCPU is inferred across the gap.

other_evidence.immutable_server_logs: final-evidence/server.log and server.err.log truncated to final measured sample bytecounts

limits: Process-wideCPU cannot establish browser latency or exact request/function attribution.
2-second sampledRSS can miss brief spikes; lifetimepeak spans all process activity since launch.
Serveraccesslogs have no per-line timestamps/durations; completionappend windows are bracketed by sampled file sizes.
The audit includes initial loading, cold member replacement, and varied operations; initial-to-finalRSS increase alone is not evidence of a leak.
No continuous-coverage claim: the20:14:21–20:19:27 gap is explicit.
Final screenshot and dashboard-order restoration were authorized by parent only after the final passiveidle sample; later server activity is outside this summary.
